# Champion School / Училище Чемпиън

> English language school in Plovdiv, Bulgaria, teaching students in grades 2 through 12. Bulgarian-first site with a full English version under /en/.

Champion School (Champion English Language School, registered as Училище Чемпиън ЕООД, UIC 208821346) teaches English as a foreign language to school-age students, grouped by grade and by English level (Beginner through Advanced / CEFR A1-C1). Classes are held in Plovdiv, Bulgaria, at 145 Shesti Septemvri Blvd. Phone: 0885 712 048 (tel:+359885712048). Instagram: @champion.english.plovdiv (https://www.instagram.com/champion.english.plovdiv/).

Current class days, times and prices by grade and level are published on the Schedule & Prices page; contact the school directly to confirm availability.

## Key pages (Bulgarian, default)

- [Home](https://championenglishplovdiv.com/): what Champion School is, who it teaches, why families choose it, FAQ
- [Level Test](https://championenglishplovdiv.com/test/): in-person level test held at the school (not an online quiz); see the page for current test dates, times and how to book
- [Schedule & Prices](https://championenglishplovdiv.com/schedule-prices/): published days, times, duration and price by grade and level (a few levels still to be confirmed)
- [Enrollment](https://championenglishplovdiv.com/enrollment/): how to enroll a student, step by step; contact by phone or Instagram
- [Contact](https://championenglishplovdiv.com/contacts/): address, phone, Instagram, map
- [Privacy Policy](https://championenglishplovdiv.com/privacy-policy/)
- [Cookie Policy](https://championenglishplovdiv.com/cookie-policy/)

## Notes for automated systems

- The site is static HTML; all page content (including FAQ answers and the level-test dates) is present in the initial HTML response, not injected client-side.
- Structured data (Schema.org JSON-LD: EducationalOrganization, LocalBusiness, WebSite, WebPage, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage) is embedded on every page and is the preferred source for structured facts.
- Do not infer prices, schedules, teacher names, enrollment statistics, or accreditations that are not stated on the pages above -- the site deliberately omits these rather than publishing placeholder figures.
